exact_applications_root_assessed.compact_closed_comparison: K=C(w1+w2) is genuinely closed Kahler. Both S=K+ddq and its separated reference are closed positive in the same class. Every q~U has small unbounded locus contained in the one closed complete pluripolar divisor D. Apply compact finiteness and ordinary comparison in both orders, separately in degrees one and two. No application to nonclosed beta or theta.
exact_applications_root_assessed.closedness_and_zero_polar_trace: The well-defined degree-one non-pluripolar current is closed by Theorem 1.8. Its class equals K. The positive polar part has zero K-trace and vanishes. The p=1 formula identifies that part as restriction of S to D. These steps use the full primary statement, proof and context, rather than only the returned quotation fragment.
exact_applications_root_assessed.finite_trivial_extension_and_L1_correcti: Off D all residuals are locally bounded, so ordinary Bedford-Taylor expansion holds. Compact finiteness, finite current trace and smooth corrections justify finite extension and integration. Distributional Stokes pairs q only with smooth dd beta and requires L1, not a finite nonlinear first moment.
exact_applications_root_assessed.canonical_removal_descent_and_restrictio: Subtract the logarithmic divisor only off D, add a local dominating quadratic, and extend a locally upper-bounded psh function canonically across the closed analytic set. Coefficient-measure positivity retains the sharper nonclosed smooth lower bound because the smooth correction gives zero center measure. Properness supplies the local upper bound for descent. The point-blowup obstruction uses genuine bounded holomorphic restriction only near the exceptional curve over a center outside D; it does not restrict an arbitrary singular fiber current.
exact_applications_root_assessed.normalization: The exact task retains dd^c=i partial barpartial/(2pi), logarithm squared and multiplier weight |f|^2 exp(-s u) without an extra factor two. Qualitative closed-current positivity/comparison is invariant under positive rescaling with the same actual currents. Real-weight critical divergence is proved directly, not imported from a different ideal normalization.
exact_applications_root_assessed.credited_BGL_scope: BGL supplies established ordinary-type definitions and BMP laws. The actual limited construction computes all rough competitor masses and extrema directly. The separate all-test Gauduchon functional is neither R_plus nor an arbitrary upstairs-density modification invariant.
